name: Sekk Brassscale
source_profile: ● Sekk Brassscale (CN) is the commander of a coalition of river hunters who increasingly attacks boats suspected of damaging Ssaresh fishing grounds. He regards Ishkara's diplomacy as ineffective.
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, p. 54 (source excerpt; may be partial)
